identification: Rough-sawn live-edge timber slab catalogued SLAB OF HUON PINE. Photo shows pale straw timber with fine growth rings, sheared bark edges, pin knots, chalked 1117 and 20/11/26. Species not provable from one photo (could be Huon, celery top or similar pale softwood). Size not given, about 2 m by an estimated 30 to 40 cm wide.

entries.note: Page opened (curl). Raw material price per cubic metre, not a slab sale. A slab about 2 m x 0.35 m x 0.05 m is about 0.035 m3, so about $40 to $155 at that rate; dressed, kiln dried retail slabs cost several times more. Shows the timber is not worth hundreds unless wide, thick and figured.

WebSearch was refused (search budget used up), so no web resale search ran. Curled Island Specialty Timbers price archive (opened); huonpine.com.au and two other dealer guesses returned no prices. No SOLD resale evidence found outside Gowans. eBay sold listings for 'huon pine slab' and Tasmanian dealer retail slab prices would settle resale.
chrome_hint: eBay Australia sold/completed listings: huon pine slab live edge (also 'huon pine board'); and dealer sites for per-slab retail (e.g. Tasmanian timber dealers, Gumtree) for slabs about 2 m long, 300-400 mm wide
rate_note: All prices AUD, no conversion. Gowans prices are hammer, premium about 19.8% extra.
viewing_check: Smell a fresh cut or scratch (Huon pine has a strong distinctive oil aroma), look at end grain for very fine, even rings, and measure length, width and thickness. Photograph both faces and the end. Check for splits, rot, borer and any wide figured or birdseye area.
